title: Sunset Shack (sample)
blurb: A sample listing: this is how a shack, a café or a small shop appears in virtual Goa.

pitch: Patrao! Sunset Shack, kingfish thali fresh from the boats. Sunbeds free if you eat with us!

text: Run by the same family for twenty seasons. Sunbeds are free when you order, the fish comes off the boats at seven, and the sunset is on the house.
